params.note: Hardware validation run for the Phase 3 growth-rate detector (bela/detector-passthrough/). Gain cells at unity -- actuator disabled by design. armed_count confirmed 0 throughout via live pybela streaming during the run (no false arming on real ambient room noise) -- this followed fixing a real bug the same day: the cheap local-shoulder prominence proxy at 6 dB (matching the Python reference) false-armed 150-230 of 1025 bins continuously on a real quiet recording; found and fixed offline before this run by raising it to 25 dB, revalidated against the same recording and against the synthetic fast-jump test with no change in detection latency. No genuine feedback jump has been captured on any rig yet, so the actual Phase 3 exit criterion (ms from a real jump to a growth-rate flag) remains open -- see host/harness/detector.py and host/tests/test_detector.py for the synthetic validation that does exist (sub-50ms arm latency at 500 dB/s growth, no false arms on stationary signal or noise floor).
